documents.topic: Can pure Swift 6.3 ownership vocabulary replace Property / Property.Typed / Property.Consuming / Property.View at equivalent ergonomics? Per-family verdict backed by four executable experiments.
documents.statusDetail: RETAIN all four families. Pure language has every mechanism (~Copyable, ~Escapable, @_lifetime, consuming/borrowing conventions) but the types' value is per-ecosystem amortization and centralised compiler-bug absorption, not language-capability gap-filling. The handoff's worked example `container.forEach { process(consume $0) }` is REFUTED on compiler-evidenced grounds (no-op warning on Copyable elements; container unchanged). All four families PARTIALLY-REPLACEABLE per namespace; none REPLACEABLE ecosystem-wide at equivalent ergonomics.
